title: Responses to Extreme Temperatures: Migrant Networks and International Migration from El Salvador
title_zh: 极端温度的反应：移民网络与萨尔瓦多的国际移民
authors: Ana Maria Ibáñez, Juliana Quigua, Maria Jimena Romero, Andrea Velásquez
abstract: We show that exposure to extreme temperatures significantly increases international migration from El Salvador, where nearly a quarter of the population lives in the United States. Extreme temperatures reduce corn yields, leading producers to decrease their use of postharvest inputs and demand for agricultural workers. These income losses, combined with established US migration networks, increase emigration. Our findings highlight how international migration serves as a response to extreme temperatures when destination networks are strong and migration remains financially feasible. This pattern is not unique to El Salvador: Roughly 30 million farms globally are in low-income settings with access to remittances. (JEL F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54)
abstract_zh: 研究表明，极端气温显著增加了萨尔瓦多的国际移民——该国近四分之一人口居住在美国。极端气温导致玉米减产，促使生产者减少收获后投入品的使用并降低对农业劳动力的需求。这些收入损失，加上已建立的美国移民网络，进一步推动了移民潮。我们的发现凸显了当目的地移民网络强大且移民在经济上仍可行时，国际移民如何成为应对极端气温的一种手段。这一现象并非萨尔瓦多独有：全球约有3000万个农场位于低收入地区，且这些地区能够获得汇款。（JEL分类号：F24, J15, J23, J43, O15, Q12, Q54）

title: Macroeconomic Drivers of Corporate Investment in the United Kingdom: A Multivariate Analysis
title_zh: 英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素：一项多元分析
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines the macroeconomic drivers of corporate investment in the United Kingdom using a multivariate time-series framework. Focusing on five key variables-interest rates, inflation, GDP growth, exchange rates, and corporate profits-the analysis investigates their combined effects on aggregate corporate investment using annual data from 1990 to 2022. By concentrating on macroeconomic determinants rather than firm-level factors, the study provides evidence on how monetary and real-sector conditions shape investment behavior in a mature, market-based economy. The contribution of this study lies in integrating long-run macroeconomic trends within a multivariate econometric framework that captures interactions between corporate profits, inflation, and exchange-rate movements in the UK over three decades of evolving policy regimes. Given the mixed order of integration among the variables, the study employs an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach to examine long-run relationships and short-run adjustment dynamics. OLS and Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS) estimates are retained as benchmark and robustness checks. The results indicate that higher interest rates exert a significant positive effect on corporate investment, consistent with the endogenous and pro-cyclical nature of UK monetary policy. Corporate profits have a strong positive influence, highlighting the importance of internal finance. Inflation exhibits a negative and significant impact, while GDP growth shows a weak accelerator effect and exchange-rate movements are statistically insignificant. These findings underscore the dominance of profitability and policy credibility in driving UK investment and offer relevant insights for sustaining long-term capital formation.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用多元时间序列框架，考察英国企业投资的宏观经济驱动因素。聚焦利率、通胀、GDP增长、汇率及企业利润五大关键变量，基于1990年至2022年的年度数据，分析其对总体企业投资的综合影响。通过聚焦宏观层面而非企业层面的决定因素，本研究揭示了货币与实体部门条件如何塑造成熟市场经济体的投资行为。本研究的贡献在于，将长期宏观经济趋势整合至多元计量框架中，捕捉英国三十年间政策体制演变下企业利润、通胀与汇率波动之间的交互作用。鉴于变量间存在混合阶数整合特征，研究采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验法，考察长期关系与短期调整动态。同时保留普通最小二乘法（OLS）与两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）的估计结果，作为基准检验与稳健性验证。结果表明：利率上升对企业投资具有显著正向效应，这与英国货币政策的内生性与顺周期性特征一致；企业利润呈现强正向影响，凸显内部融资的重要性；通胀具有显著负向影响，而GDP增长仅呈现微弱加速效应，汇率波动则无统计显著性。这些发现强调了盈利能力与政策可信度对英国投资的主导作用，为维持长期资本形成提供了相关启示。

title: Can AI Replace Human Counselors at Scale? A Nationwide Experiment to Reduce Teacher Shortages
title_zh: AI能否大规模替代人类辅导员？一项旨在缓解教师短缺的全国性实验
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The effectiveness of many interventions depends on implementer quality; as programs scale and the pool of implementers broadens, average quality falls. Conversation-based interventions, such as counseling or peer mentoring, are particularly sensitive to implementer skill. LLMs offer a natural way out: they can hold personalized exchanges at zero marginal cost and uniform quality. Whether AI can replicate, or even improve on, the human skills thought to make such interventions effective remains an open question. We run a nationwide experiment in Chile (N=41,000) comparing an AI-powered chatbot, Kai, with trained human counselors. Both arms reach high school seniors via WhatsApp and aim to motivate them toward teaching careers, addressing future teacher shortages. Among students with baseline interest in teaching (the main target of the intervention) Kai significantly increases the probability of ranking an education major first as well as the share of education majors in students' choice sets; estimates in the human arm are smaller and not statistically significant. We use text analysis to characterize conversational attributes and test mechanisms. Both arms cover a comparable breadth of topics, but Kai concentrates on factual content while human counselors lean on subjective, socioemotional material. Kai's exchanges are substantially faster and more dynamic, with near-instantaneous responses and shorter student gaps, and more semantically coherent on both sides. Human counselors, in turn, score substantially higher on motivation and empathy. We interpret these results as evidence that AI relaxes the implementer-quality constraint in conversation-based interventions at scale.
abstract_zh: 许多干预措施的有效性取决于实施者的素质；随着项目规模扩大和实施者群体拓宽，平均素质会下降。基于对话的干预措施（如咨询或同伴指导）对实施者的技能尤为敏感。大语言模型提供了一种自然的解决方案：它们能够以零边际成本和统一质量进行个性化交流。人工智能能否复制甚至提升被认为使此类干预措施有效的人类技能，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们在智利开展了一项全国性实验（样本量N=41,000），将人工智能驱动的聊天机器人Kai与受过培训的人类咨询师进行对比。两组干预均通过WhatsApp联系高中毕业生，旨在激励他们选择教师职业，以应对未来教师短缺问题。在基线阶段对教学职业感兴趣的学生（干预的主要目标群体）中，Kai显著提高了他们将教育专业列为第一志愿的概率，以及教育专业在学生选择组合中的占比；而人类咨询师组的估计值较小且未达到统计显著性。我们通过文本分析来刻画对话特征并检验作用机制。两组干预覆盖的话题广度相当，但Kai侧重于事实性内容，而人类咨询师更依赖主观的社会情感素材。Kai的对话速度更快、互动性更强，表现为近乎即时的回复和更短的学生回应间隔，且双方对话的语义连贯性更高。相比之下，人类咨询师在动机激发和共情能力方面得分显著更高。我们将这些结果解读为：人工智能在规模化实施基于对话的干预措施时，能够缓解实施者素质这一约束条件。

title: The Bright Side of Tax Evasion
abstract: This paper investigates whether tax evasion opportunities can increase tax revenue. Past theoretical discussions have presented mixed outcomes as to whether allowing taxpayers to opt into uncertainty could indeed enhance overall tax revenues. In this study, we conducted a series of original real-effort experiments in an online setting with almost 6,000 participants to test this hypothesis empirically. Our findings show significant positive labour supply responses to the opportunity to evade (increased labour supply by 30%). More importantly, the expected tax revenue significantly and substantially increased by up to 40%. Strikingly, this effect persists when comparing effective tax rates: Lowering effective tax rates through probabilistic enforcement (the opportunity to evade) is more efficient than simply lowering statutory tax rates. Our findings suggest that the opportunity for tax evasion can increase tax revenues beyond what a corresponding decrease in nominal rates would achieve.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨逃税机会能否增加税收收入。以往的理论讨论对于允许纳税人选择不确定性是否确实能提高整体税收收入，得出了相互矛盾的结果。在本研究中，我们通过在线环境开展了一系列原创的真实努力实验，涉及近6000名参与者，以实证检验这一假设。研究结果显示，逃税机会显著激发了劳动供给的正向反应（劳动供给增加30%）。更重要的是，预期税收收入显著且大幅增长，增幅高达40%。引人注目的是，在比较有效税率时，这一效应依然存在：通过概率性执法（即逃税机会）降低有效税率，比单纯降低法定税率更为高效。我们的发现表明，逃税机会带来的税收收入增长，可能超过相应名义税率下调所能实现的效果。
